bool IsAlive(
    Entity entity) const noexcept
{
    return
        !entity.IsNull() &&
        entity.Index <
            m_Generations.size() &&
        m_Alive[entity.Index] &&
        m_Generations[entity.Index] ==
            entity.Generation;
}
